title: agent_families.yaml
description: Schema for the agent families registry. Each family declares (a) launch contract — bin / version_flag / supports / incompatibilities / launch (per-mode mode-selecting argv, ADR-043) — and (b) optional frame_profile — declarative stream-json translation rules per ADR-010. Editor LSPs use this for autocomplete + inline validation; AI agent maintainers use it as a structural reference alongside docs/reference/frame-profiles.md.

family.description: Wire-level family name. Used in hosts.capabilities_json, template backend.kind, audit rows, and as the overlay-file basename. Lowercase-hyphenated.

version_flag.description: Argument the probe runs to read a version string. Empty/omitted skips the version probe.

supports.description: Mode tokens this family is known to support; consumed by modes.Resolve to reject incompatible spawn requests.

launch.description: Per-driving-mode input/launch contract — the argv that selects the engine's mode (ADR-043). The input-side mirror of frame_profile. Keyed by driving mode (M1/M2/M4); only flag-gated modes need an entry. The launcher appends mode_args to the rendered persona command so persona templates carry bin + intent only.

permission_modes.description: Flag-time permission contract (ADR-043 P3): per permission mode (skip / prompt), the argv the spawn resolver substitutes into a persona template's {{permission_flag}}. claude-code only. A persona template that omits permission_modes inherits this; one that declares its own overrides. Values may embed {{mcp_namespace}}.

frame_profile.description: Per-engine declarative translator for stream-json frames. Optional in v1; nil falls back to the legacy hardcoded translator (driver_stdio.go).

frame_translator.description: Selects which translator the host-runner uses. Empty/'legacy' (default) → hardcoded translate(); 'profile' → ApplyProfile authoritative; 'both' → profile authoritative + legacy shadow with divergence logging (ADR-010 Phase 1.6 canary).

default_auth_method.description: Family-level fallback for the ACP `authenticate` method id when the steward template doesn't specify one (ADR-021 D3). Empty means no default — the driver falls through to the first non-interactive method, or raises an attention_request when only interactive ones exist.

runtime_mode_switch.description: How runtime mode/model switching dispatches, per driving mode (ADR-021 D4). A mode this family hasn't declared is treated as 'unsupported' so the picker degrades safely.

ModalitySupport.description: Per-driving-mode support for one prompt modality (ADR-021 D5 / artifact-type-registry W7.2). Keyed by mode because an engine can accept a modality on one wire and strip it on another (gemini-cli: images on M1, not M2). Composers gate their attach affordance on this; the hub validates MIME + caps regardless. Missing key = not supported.

mode_args.description: Mode-selecting argv for this (family, mode) — e.g. claude-code M2's [--print, --output-format, stream-json, --input-format, stream-json, --verbose]. Appended to the rendered persona command by the launcher (ADR-043). Order preserved.

description.description: Agent-facing prose header. ~3 lines stating dispatch semantics + scope conventions inline so a fresh maintainer reading rule 17 sees the model. Optional but strongly recommended.

profile_version.description: Schema version. Loaders accept lower versions when forward-compatible; unknown higher versions are rejected so old hubs don't silently misbehave on a new overlay.

match.description: AND-ed top-level field equality. Empty match (or absent) matches any frame at lowest specificity. Specificity = number of keys; most-specific match wins, ties fire in declaration order.

for_each.description: Optional. Expression yielding an array; the rule fires once per element with that element as inner scope ($.) and the parent frame as outer scope ($$.).

when_present.description: Optional. Gates the emit on a non-nil expression evaluation. Used so usage events don't fire as all-nils when the SDK omits message.usage. A gated rule does not trigger the raw fallback.

sub_rules.description: Only meaningful with for_each. Per-element dispatch on inner-scope shape (e.g. content[].type ∈ {text, tool_use}). First sub-rule whose match is satisfied fires.

kind.description: agent_event kind column. Reuse existing kinds where possible (text, tool_call, tool_result, usage, rate_limit, session.init, system, error, raw, …); a new kind requires mobile renderer support.

producer.description: Producer column. Default 'agent'. Override for system-originated frames to 'system' or for hub-side rules to 'hub'.

payload.description: Map of output field → expression. Expressions are evaluated in the rule's scope (inner if inside for_each, outer via $$.) and resolved to the agent_event row's payload_json. Mutually exclusive with payload_expr.

payload_maps.description: Payload fields whose value is an object KEYED BY DATA (claude's modelUsage, keyed by model id). Each source value is re-shaped through `fields` while the source's keys are preserved. Merged with payload; a plain payload field wins a name collision. Mutually exclusive with payload_expr.

payload_lists.description: Payload fields whose value is an ARRAY of engine-shaped objects that stay one list (codex's turn/plan/updated steps). Each element is re-shaped through `fields`, order preserved. Not for_each — for_each turns an array into N events, this turns an array into one field. Merged with payload; a plain payload field wins a name collision. Mutually exclusive with payload_expr.

payload_expr.description: Single expression yielding the *entire* payload (whole-payload passthrough). Used when the legacy translator passes the raw frame as payload — system fallback, error, deprecated completion alias. Must resolve to a map; non-map values yield an empty payload defensively. Mutually exclusive with payload / payload_maps / payload_lists (payload_expr wins if both are set).

Projection.description: Re-shapes a collection element-wise through one field expression map. Used by payload_maps (over a map's values) and payload_lists (over an array's elements). An absent or wrong-typed source omits the payload field entirely; elements that aren't objects are skipped.

source.description: Expression resolving to the collection to walk — a map for payload_maps, an array for payload_lists.

fields.description: Map of output field → expression, evaluated once per element with that element as the inner scope ($.) and the rule's own scope as the outer scope ($$.).
